name: AD-1211
summary: AD-1211 is an opioid analgesic drug invented in the 1970s by Dainippon Pharmaceutical Co. It is chemically a 1-substituted-4-prenyl-piperazine derivative, which is structurally unrelated to most other opioid drugs.

pharmacology.text: The (S)-enantiomers in this series are more active as opioid agonists, but the less active (R)-enantiomer of this compound, AD-1211, is a mixed agonist–antagonist at opioid receptors with a similar pharmacological profile to pentazocine, and has atypical opioid effects with little development of tolerance or dependence seen after extended administration in animal studies.

summaryZh: AD-1211是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C23H30N2O，屬於類阿片鎮痛藥，1970年代由大日本製藥株式會社（住友製藥株式會社的前身）研發，藥理學特性與噴他佐辛相似。

uses.en: It is a research compound invented in the 1970s and was never marketed as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是1970年代合成的研究用化合物，從未作為藥品上市。
uses.zhHans: 它是1970年代合成的研究用化合物，从未作为药品上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. As a mixed agonist and antagonist at opioid receptors, it would be expected to cause drowsiness, nausea and dizziness, and such drugs can bring on withdrawal in people dependent on opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作為鴉片受體的混合型促效與拮抗劑，預期它會引起嗜睡、噁心與頭暈；這類藥物也可能讓已對鴉片類藥物產生依賴的人進入戒斷狀態。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作为鸦片受体的混合型促效与拮抗剂，预期它会引起嗜睡、恶心与头晕；这类药物也可能让已对鸦片类药物产生依赖的人进入戒断状态。

fact.en: It is unusual among opioids in being built on a piperazine ring rather than the ring systems of morphine or fentanyl, so it is chemically unrelated to almost every other opioid.
fact.zh: 在鴉片類藥物中它相當特別，骨架是哌嗪環，而不是嗎啡或吩坦尼的環系，因此在化學上幾乎與其他所有鴉片類藥物都無關。
fact.zhHans: 在鸦片类药物中它相当特别，骨架是哌嗪环，而不是吗啡或吩坦尼的环系，因此在化学上几乎与其他所有鸦片类药物都无关。
